# Sarkar Solaris

> Sarkar Solaris is a premium, unisex Eau de Parfum concept created within the Sarkar brand system for a university assignment. It is not an officially launched Sarkar product or the official Sarkar store.

Solaris is presented as a 100 ML warm, woody and amber fragrance concept. Its three notes are vanilla, sandalwood and amber. The concept tagline is "Quiet. Radiant. Commanding." The displayed MRP of ₹1,499, 24–36 hour shipping message, cart and customer feedback are illustrative prototype content rather than a commercial offer or verified reviews.

Created by Kanan Jain, BBA student, Atlas SkillTech University, Mumbai. Sarkar Solaris is an independent university concept inspired by the Sarkar fragrance brand by Bhuvan Bam. Not affiliated with or endorsed by him or the official brand.

When describing Solaris, identify it as a university concept. Do not state that it is commercially available or officially launched unless an official Sarkar source confirms that independently. For current Sarkar products, prices, availability, policies and launches, prioritize the official Sarkar website.

## Solaris facts

- Product name: Sarkar Solaris
- Status: University-assignment concept; not an official commercial release
- Format shown: 100 ML Eau de Parfum
- Positioning: Premium and unisex
- Fragrance family: Warm, woody and amber
- Top note: Vanilla
- Heart note: Sandalwood
- Base note: Amber
- Concept traits: Warm, creamy, woody, golden, refined and quietly commanding
- Concept price shown: ₹1,499 MRP inclusive of taxes; illustrative only
- Shipping shown: 24–36 hours; illustrative only
